description: This file contains test cases for Gateway authentication logic within an Android project. It verifies behaviors such as operator session connection decisions, handling of bootstrap tokens, and TLS fingerprint prompts using the Robolectric testing framework.

classes.name: GatewayBootstrapAuthTest
classes.description: Test class for Gateway bootstrap and authentication logic in Android using Robolectric.

methods.name: skipsOperatorSessionWhenOnlyBootstrapAuthExists
methods.description: Tests that operator sessions are skipped when only bootstrap auth exists.

methods.name: connectsOperatorSessionWhenSharedPasswordOrStoredAuthExists
methods.description: Tests that operator sessions connect when shared password or stored auth is available.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthUsesStoredTokenPathAfterBootstrapHandoff
methods.description: Verifies that after bootstrap handoff, resolved auth uses the stored token path.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthPrefersExplicitSharedAuth
methods.description: Ensures explicit shared authentication takes precedence over stored tokens.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth_prefersExplicitSetupAuthOverStoredPrefs
methods.description: Tests that explicit setup auth overrides stored preferences when resolving gateway auth.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt_preservesExplicitSetupAuth
methods.description: Checks that accepting the gateway trust prompt preserves the explicit setup auth token.

methods.name: connect_showsSecureEndpointGuidanceWhenTlsProbeFails
methods.description: Ensures guidance is shown when TLS probe indicates failure, simulating TLS unavailability.

methods.name: waitForGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Utility to wait for the gateway trust prompt to appear.

methods.name: waitForStatusText
methods.description: Utility to wait for specific status text updates during tests.

methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token from runtime state using reflection.
